additional_requirements: Functioning is not markedly impaired apart from the impact of the delusion(s) or its ramifications

S019.name: Delusions
S019.description: Fixed beliefs that do not change easily, even in the face of contradictory evidence.

subtypes.Persecutory Delusions: The false belief that one is being harmed or monitored by other people or organizations.
subtypes.Referential Delusions: The conviction that ordinary events, remarks, or behaviors have specific relevance to oneself.
subtypes.Grandiose Delusions: The false belief that one possesses special abilities, power, or fame.
subtypes.Erotomanic Delusions: The false belief that another person is in love with or has affection for them.
subtypes.Nihilistic Delusions: A destructive or negative conviction that the world is ending or that a major catastrophe will occur.
subtypes.Somatic Delusions: The baseless conviction that there is a serious abnormality with one's body or organs.
subtypes.Jealous Delusions: The conviction that one's spouse or romantic partner is being unfaithful without sufficient evidence.

symptom.disease_info: Delusional Disorder is characterized by one or more fixed delusional beliefs lasting at least one month, without the broader disorganization, hallucinations, or negative symptoms typical of schizophrenia. Functioning may remain relatively intact outside the area touched by the belief, and the presentation is often organized and plausible enough that the condition becomes evident only when the belief persists despite clear contradictory evidence.

patient.stressor: Marwan downsized from his long-familiar Endicott home to a smaller apartment closer to galleries and the Finger Lakes, intending the move to simplify consulting work and give him more time for painting. Small disruptions that followed the move—misdelivered mail, unfamiliar building noises, and disagreements with the property manager—became the starting point for fixed beliefs that remained unchanged over the next 11 months despite practical explanations and documentation. As the belief became more central, he withdrew from several consulting commitments, repeatedly sought confirmation from neighbors and local offices, and became increasingly unable to settle into the routines that had previously organized his days. He entered psychiatric care after a community mediation meeting about his housing complaints ended with the mediator and his primary care clinician jointly recommending an urgent mental health evaluation.

S019.name: Delusions
S019.description: Fixed beliefs that do not change easily, even in the face of contradictory evidence.
S019.manifestation: I’m here because for months now the property manager and certain people in the building have been using misdelivered mail, timed noises in the walls, and little comments from neighbors to pressure me out of the apartment, and no amount of their paperwork or explanations changes the pattern I can see.

add_requirements.Functioning is not markedly impaired apa: When I’m not dealing with the apartment situation, I can still manage my finances, cook for myself, keep appointments, and discuss consulting or painting in an organized way.
add_requirements.functional_impairment: I’ve pulled back from several consulting jobs and spend much of my week following up with neighbors, offices, and building staff instead of settling into my normal work and painting routine.
add_requirements.duration: This has been going on for about 11 months, since shortly after I moved into the new apartment.
